messages:
Nina: Clearing out some office clutter before the team shuffle  free anti-fatigue standing mat (black, 36x20in) and a small two-seater couch (good condition, cat-free). Pickup SF office mezzanine by Thu evening. Pics: https://imgur.com/standmatcouch :couch:
Omar: Interested in the mat! Does it have a textured surface or non-slip underside?
Nina: Non-slip underside, slight wear near the edge but totally usable. No smells.
Zoe: I could use the couch if it's not huge. Does it fit through standard doorways?
Nina: Yes fits through a 30in doorway if you angle it. I can help carry down if needed.
Kelvin: Can I reserve the mat? I start a week of standing demos and would love it. I can pick up Wed lunch.
Nina: Kelvin you have first dibs on the mat. I'll leave a sticky note with your name and cell.
Omar: If Kelvin takes the mat, can I snag the couch instead? I live nearby and can pick up Thu 6pm.
Nina: Couch claim order: Zoe first if she's sure, then Omar. Zoe are you definite?
Zoe: Pretty sure yes, just need to check apartment measurements. Can confirm by EOD Tue.
OfficeBot: :information_source: Reminder: please label items placed in common areas with owner and pickup deadline. Unclaimed items may be moved to the swap shelf after 72 hours.
Kelvin: Confirmed pickup Wed 12:30pm. I'll bring a dolly for the couch if Omar/Zoe need help.
Nina: Thanks everyone. If Zoe passes, Omar I'll DM pickup details. I'll tape the mat to the bench labeled "NINA - KELVIN" so nobody accidentally claims it.
Zoe: Confirmed I can take the couch! DM'ing for logistics. Thanks Nina :heart:
Omar: Cool, if you need an extra hand let me know. I'll stand by for updates.
Nina: Great  couch is reserved for Zoe, mat reserved for Kelvin. I'll move any leftover small items to the swap shelf after Friday. Cheers!
